summary: Full backend API test suite executed against public preview URL. 44/45 tests passed (97.7%). Verified auth (admin/customer/farmer), products CRUD with RBAC, categories, cart, wishlist, orders (cod/upi + razorpay-disabled-400), AI (price-predict, chat SSE, recommend with 4 picks), admin/farmer analytics, image upload+serve, and CORS. Fixed one real backend bug in /api/ai/chat where an unused Optional[dict] param made FastAPI treat the payload as nested, breaking the endpoint (422). After fix, chat SSE streams delta + done as expected. Only failing test is a CORS preflight assertion which is caused by k8s ingress handling OPTIONS before FastAPI (returns allow-origin:* without allow-credentials); FastAPI's own CORSMiddleware is configured correctly with FRONTEND_URL.

minor.issue: Kubernetes ingress intercepts CORS preflight and returns 'access-control-allow-origin: *' without 'access-control-allow-credentials: true'. Cookie-based cross-origin auth from other origins would fail. Same-origin and Bearer-token auth are unaffected. Likely infra/ingress config, not app code.
FIXED by testing agent: endpoint signature had 'user: Optional[dict] = None' which FastAPI treated as an additional body field, breaking payload parsing (returned 422). Removed the unused param.

action_items: Review the /api/ai/chat fix (removed unused user param) in server.py - no functional regression, endpoint is public as intended.
If cross-origin cookie auth is required, review ingress CORS handling. Current Bearer-token/localStorage fallback already works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 752 lines - approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider splitting routes into modules (auth/products/orders/ai/admin).
Razorpay client initialized at module import; if env keys added later, a restart is required (acceptable).
_calc_totals subtotal treats fractional prices as ints via round() for gst/delivery — OK, but total keeps float precision; consistent rounding recommended.

get_current_user is applied per-route rather than via router-level dependency; consistent, but consider a router with dependencies=[Depends(get_current_user)] for authed endpoints to prevent regressions like the ai_chat bug.
cart 'quantity' on update accepts negative -> deletes; that behavior is fine but not documented in Pydantic (Field(ge=0)) — add validators to reject bad data.
wishlist toggle uses raw dict body instead of Pydantic model — inconsistent validation.
verify_farmer returns {ok:true} even when farmer id doesn't exist (update matched 0). Return 404 when no doc updated.

rca of the issue: AI chat 422: FastAPI resolves parameters typed as pydantic/dict without an explicit Query/Header/Depends as request-body params. Adding 'user: Optional[dict] = None' next to a BaseModel body param made FastAPI expect a nested body with fields 'payload' and 'user'. Fix: removed the unused user param. Mitigation going forward: use Depends(get_current_user) with Optional wrapper OR explicit typing to avoid FastAPI treating dicts as body.
